name: Further Mysteries
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I decrypted the letter, but I don't know what to make of it.  You found this among thieves in the Alterac foothills?  Very strange...

You should take this to the magistrate of Southshore.  Although this letter is cryptic, his is the closest town to Alterac; if a threat is brewing, then he should know.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Decrypted Letter to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore.
narrative.offerRewardText:
<Maleb reads the letter.>

This is translated from a letter you found in a Syndicate encampment? This was not written by a thief, or even a noble of Alterac.

It appears The Syndicate has ties to another power, and I shudder to think what that might be.
narrative.requestItemsText: adventurer. Have you been traveling through the foothills and mountains again? What news do you bring?
